query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

action.query: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026

content.text:
In **Massachusetts**, the current **maximum unemployment insurance benefit is $1,105 per week** for claims filed on or after **October 5, 2025**. Benefits are generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at that amount. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

You may also get an extra **$25 per week per dependent child**, but the dependency allowance is capped at **50% of your weekly benefit amount**. ([legalclarity.org](https://legalclarity.org/massachusetts-unemployment-insurance-law-rules-and-benefits/?utm_source=openai))

Massachusetts unemployment can last up to **30 weeks**, so the maximum regular benefit could be up to **$33,150** before any dependency allowance, if you qualify for the full weekly max for all 30 weeks. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))
